blocks.text: Let's look at this one. Which of these steps use the subtraction property of equality? Choose all that apply.
blocks.display: Which of these steps use the subtraction property of equality? Select all that apply.

blocks.text: X plus nine equals twelve becomes x equals three. Nine is subtracted from both sides: the subtraction property.
Five x equals three x plus eight becomes two x equals eight. Three x is subtracted from both sides: the subtraction property.
X minus two equals seven becomes x equals nine. Two is added to both sides, so this is the addition property.
Four x equals twenty becomes x equals five. Both sides are divided by four, so this is the division property.
Three x plus six equals twenty-one becomes three x equals fifteen. Six is subtracted from both sides: the subtraction property.
Three steps use the subtraction property: taking nine away, taking three x away, and taking six away. In each one, the same amount leaves both sides.
